violations.why: irq_amber can preempt irq_fern between the increment and the read-back, so the read sees 0 instead of the incremented value.
The v_loom++ read-modify-write in irq_fern can be preempted by irq_amber's reset, and the stale value is then written back.
irq_amber can write v_loom between irq_fern's read and its write of 0. The earlier read result then no longer matches the state.
irq_cobalt has higher priority and can preempt irq_fern and reset v_loom between the write and the read.
irq_cobalt can preempt irq_amber between its write and its check of v_loom, so the check may see a different value.
irq_cobalt can reset v_beacon in the middle of irq_fern's v_beacon++, and the stale increment overwrites the reset.
irq_cobalt can reset v_ridge between irq_fern's use of it as an array index and its increment, so the two reads disagree.
irq_cobalt can reset v_ridge in the middle of irq_fern's v_ridge++, and the stale value is then written back.
